card.name: Positions just before the word string
card.fires_on: Odd spots in the text where the next word could plausibly be "string" or "strings", such as after "G" in "G String", before "strings" of floaters, or mid-word in broken text. The marked word itself is varied and often a fragment or punctuation.

modes.label: Before string as an object
modes.description: The marked spot sits right before a literal string, like a violin string or a rope under tension.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word string or strings next, and away from unrelated rare tokens.
card.plain: It fires where the word "string" might come next, such as a guitar string or stringy floaters in the eye, but also in some garbled text.
